notes.title: Developer Q and A
notes.content: Hey guys!  We'll be answering questions to the upcoming game Love Me Forever.  Post us your questions here. Link: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1192540/eventcomments/2518023667596902693/  We are also available in the Steam Chat. Day: Sunday, 21 June 2020 Time: 1:00 pm (PST) / 10:00 pm (CEST)  Check out the first demo if you haven't yet, it will only be available till the festival ends on Monday, 22 June 2020, 10:00 am (PST) / 7:00 pm (CEST).

notes.title: Demo available on Steam Game Festival (16th to 22th June)
notes.content: Hi Guys! We're excited to announce that we are participating with a playable demo of Love Me Forver on the Steam Game Festival. The Festival will be from 16th to 22th June 2020. The demo will include the full prologue of the game, and will be available in english and german.  Add the game to your wishlist, and follow it to recieve a notification when the demo is available.
